method: Simulated only. No fees, no slippage beyond quoted candle ask/bid, 1 contract per trade, no position sizing.

strategies.S0_BUY_YES_FIRST_QUOTE: Baseline: buy YES at the first quoted candle, hold to settlement.
strategies.S1_LONGSHOT_YES: Buy YES when last price first closes <= $0.10; hold to settlement.
strategies.S2_FAVOURITE_NO: Buy NO when last price first closes >= $0.90; hold to settlement.
strategies.S3_MOMENTUM_1H_YES: After a candle-to-candle rise of >= $0.10, buy YES; exit at next candle's YES bid.
strategies.S4_FADE_1H_YES: After a candle-to-candle fall of >= $0.10, buy YES; exit at next candle's YES bid.
